notes.title: New Languages, Fixes & Optimizations – Bearnard Gets a Big Patch!
notes.notes:
Hi Folks! 

At the beginning of 2025, I started working on the Nintendo Switch port, which also brought plenty of improvements and changes to the PC version. And that's not all! The latest patch adds support for 8 new languages, including several Asian ones. So if English or Polish isn't your first language, you can now enjoy the game in your own.  Below is the summary of the most important changes and fixes. 

Fixed:

Fixed occasional problems when connecting / disconnecting a gamepad

Scrolls panel do not stay on a screen when the game is unpaused

Fixed some edge-cases with Steam integration

Pause menu is no longer displayed when a gamepad is disconnected on a death screen

The game no longer crashes when a player rapidly clicks "Continue" button in a main menu

The game no longer crashes when a player pauses the game in a very specific moment of some cutscenes


Changed:
Translated the game to 8 new languages: Chinese Simplified and Traditional, Korean, Japanese, Spanish (LATAM), Portugese (BR), German, French

Improved English dialogues quality

Updated Godot Engine to a version 3.6. It does not bring any significant improvements for the player, but keeps me up to date and makes further patching easier

Made tons of optimizations for slower computers

Improved enemies placement / movement in some levels to make combat more appealing 



Cheers,
Mike

notes.title: Bearnard – Nintendo Switch Release Date Trailer! 🐻
notes.notes:
Not long ago, we shared the exciting news that thanks to the partnership with Untold Tales, Bearnard is coming to Nintendo Switch! 
And today we’re here to let you know it will land on the console on May 9, 2025!


Watch it now!

[previewyoutube=OXUCDQ2orlM;full][/previewyoutube]

Oh, and look, Bearnard has left you a note! 

“Hey, check me out! I can almost fit into your pocket now! I thought I was a big bear, but looks like I’m about to go portable and ready for all your on-the-go adventures!”

Okay, so where will YOU take Bearnard, starting May 9, 2025? Clearly, he seems super excited about the idea of being able to travel anywhere with you! Let us know in the comments – Bearnard’s ready to go wherever you are!

[hr][/hr]
👉 Don’t forget to add Bearnard to your wishlist at the Nintendo eShop!

[hr][/hr] 
We can’t wait for you to take Bearnard’s adventure with you on the go. 

Stay tuned for more updates!
Mike & Bearnard 🐻

notes.title: Patch notes - v1.0.44
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

Another game update has been deployed. This one focuses on game balance and minor bugs.
Here's the summary of changes and fixes:

Fixed:

 Fixed key icon of grind action when a key responsible for that action was remapped

Changed:

 There is now a limit of 3 cards per each Necromancer which may be dropped by minions
 There is only 20 % probability that a minion will drop anything
 XP for minions has been lowered from 10 to 1
 Common tier cards grind value has been lowered from 15 to 5
 Higher tier cards grind value has been lowered from 25% to 15% of its value
 Lowered maximum gold which may be dropped by a killed enemy from 10 to 5


Cheers,
Mike

notes.title: Patch notes - v1.0.43
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

A small game update has been deployed. Here's the summary of changes and fixes:

Added:

 There is now a "Continue" button in the main menu which loads the latest saved game

Fixed:

 An edge case when Bearnard's details were shown during cutscenes
 Edge cases when a Decoy or a Gift could have been stuck under a solid ground
 Some very rare bugs when loading a saved game

Changed:

 The cost of a Magic Remover card has been lowered from 3 to 2


Cheers,
Mike

notes.title: Patch notes - v1.0.42
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

It's been an incredible week for me and Bearnard. I'm thrilled that the game has been well received. Thank you for all the kind words, positive reviews, and overwhelming support.

Even though I tested the game extensively, a few minor bugs slipped through. Thanks for all the reports! Here's a quick summary of what’s been fixed recently:

Added:

 Witch description was missing — now added.

Fixed:

 Castle 01 - Barrels Puzzle: Barrels shot too high were getting stuck, which caused the gate to remain closed until a checkpoint restart. This is now fixed.
 Addressed edge cases when loading and restarting levels, which could leave Bearnard with 0 HP.
 Corrected level name translations in the Mines (Polish language).
 Fixed camera positioning when the target was too far away.
 Gamepad events now only respond to the default device, preventing double clicks/motion when using gamepad emulation software like DualSense-X or Steam Input.
 Various other minor tweaks and improvements.
 Cleaned up my desk (no more excuses for a messy workspace!).

Changed:

 Reduced traps' collision boxes for easier jumping in tight spaces.
 Improved areas with collectibles that Bearnard couldn't pick up when at 1 HP.
 Deployed traps (e.g. Blue Poo, Mine, Spikes) are now removed when combat ends, preventing players from getting stuck in tight spaces after a fight.
 Changed the "Restart level" text to "Restart challenge" when Bearnard is in a challenge room.


Cheers,
Mike
